title: The lower truncation image is flat and finitely presented on principal opens inside U
statement: Let X = Spec(A) be affine [def-pc-scheme] and let U be a quasi-compact open subscheme. Let P^\bullet be a bounded-above complex of finite free A-modules [def-pc-perfect-complex] whose associated complex on U represents an object of Tor amplitude in [a,b] [lem-pc-affine-tor-amplitude-criterion]. For an integer r<a, put K = Im(P^{r-1} \to P^r). Then for every f\in A with D(f)\subseteq U, the localized A_f-module K_f is flat and finitely presented. (Equivalently, the restriction to U of the quasi-coherent sheaf \widetilde K is flat and of finite presentation.)

source.place: Tag 08ED proof, paragraph invoking Cohomology, Lemma cohomology-lemma-last-one-flat

proof.text: Fix f with D(f) contained in U and write A_f for the localization; the localized complex P_f^\bullet of finite free A_f-modules represents the restriction to D(f)=Spec(A_f) of the object represented on U. Restriction to the open D(f) is pullback along an open immersion, which preserves Tor amplitude in [a,b] (Stacks, Cohomology, Lemma 09U8; for an open immersion j one has Lj^*=j^*, j^*(E\otimes^{\mathbf L}\mathcal G)=j^*E\otimes^{\mathbf L}j^*\mathcal G, and every \mathcal O_{D(f)}-module is j^*j_!\mathcal G'). Hence, by [lem-pc-affine-tor-amplitude-criterion] applied on Spec(A_f), H^i(P_f^\bullet\otimes_{A_f}^\mathbf L N)=0 for every A_f-module N and every i<a; since P_f^\bullet is a bounded-above complex of free modules this is H^i(P_f^\bullet\otimes_{A_f}N)=0. The module K_f is the image of P_f^{r-1}\to P_f^r.

source.place: Tag 08ED proof, paragraph invoking Cohomology, Lemma cohomology-lemma-last-one-flat

proof.text: Taking N=A_f in Step 1 gives H^{r-1}(P_f^\bullet)=0 since r-1<a, i.e. Ker(P_f^{r-1}\to P_f^r)=Im(P_f^{r-2}\to P_f^{r-1}). Hence P_f^{r-2}\to P_f^{r-1}\to K_f\to0 is exact, a finite free presentation, and K_f is finitely presented: P_f^{r-1} is finite free and the module of relations is generated by the finitely many images of a basis of P_f^{r-2}.

source.place: Tag 08ED proof, definition of K and the finite-presentation assertion

proof.text: For any A_f-module N, Step 1 gives exactness of P_f^\bullet\otimes_{A_f}N in degree r-1 (as r-1<a), so [lem-pc-module-flat-opcycles-tor-criterion], applied with a=r to the flat (indeed finite free) localized complex, makes C_f:=Coker(P_f^{r-1}\to P_f^r) flat. Since K_f=Im(P_f^{r-1}\to P_f^r), the sequence 0\to K_f\to P_f^r\to C_f\to0 is exact. As P_f^r and C_f are flat, K_f is flat (Stacks, Algebra, Lemma 00HM: the kernel of a surjection of flat modules is flat; equivalently Tor_1(K_f,N)\cong Tor_2(C_f,N)=0).

source.place: Tag 08ED proof, invocation of Cohomology, Lemma cohomology-lemma-last-one-flat

proof.text: Since f was arbitrary with D(f) contained in U, the localized module K_f is flat and finitely presented on every such principal open, which is the asserted conclusion (and is equivalent to the corresponding quasi-coherent sheaf statement on U).
